title: ARG Wallet Spend Result
description:
The response returned by AllocatedWallet.request_spend() and FinancialCircuitBreaker.request_spend(). The caller must inspect approved before making any API call — the call must not proceed if approved is false.

This schema documents the SpendResult Pydantic model in wallet.py. Every field here maps 1:1 to a field on that class.

Contract:
  - If approved=true: tokens have already been decremented from the wallet. The caller may proceed.
  - If approved=false: no tokens were decremented. The denial_reason identifies which control blocked the call.

approved.description: Whether the spend request was approved. The caller must not make the API call if this is false.

wallet_id.description: The wallet that evaluated this request.

denial_reason.description: Machine-readable reason code when approved=false. Null when approved=true.

tokens_approved.description: Number of tokens approved and decremented. Non-null only when approved=true.

cost_approved_usd.description: Cost in USD approved and decremented. Non-null only when approved=true.

operation_type.description: The operation type that was requested. Present when an operation wallet was checked.

tokens_remaining.description: Remaining tokens in the relevant wallet (mission or operation) at the time of denial. Present when approved=false to aid in escalation decisions.

burst_reserve_available.description: Number of burst reserve tokens available when denial_reason=MISSION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_BURST_RESERVE_AVAILABLE. Signals to the caller that escalation to release_burst_reserve() is possible.

mission_utilization_percent.description: Mission wallet utilization at the time of this response. Present when approved=true. Used by the circuit breaker for threshold monitoring.

warn_threshold_crossed.description: True when mission utilization crossed 75% on this specific call. The circuit breaker uses this to emit a WALLET_WARN_THRESHOLD event.

critical_threshold_crossed.description: True when mission utilization crossed 90% on this specific call. The circuit breaker uses this to emit a WALLET_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD event.
